newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lion Teck Chiang public offer 2.9 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Lion Teck Chiang public offer 2.9 times subscribed.

text.p: Lion Teck Chiang Ltd, a member of Malaysian conglomerate The Lion Group, said on Tuesday the public portion of its initial public offer (IPO) was approximately 2.9 times subscribed.
Lion Teck was offering 32.52 million ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore at Singapore $1.30 each, of which 18.1 million shares were available to the general public.
The company said 12 million shares under restricted offer were approximately 78.1 percent subscribed, and those not taken up would be allocated to satisfy applications for the public offer.

Net proceeds of approximately S$10.9 million from the nine million new shares in the offer will be used to repay debts incurred during restructuring, refinance bank borrowings, and as working capital, Lion Teck has said.
Trading in the shares is expected to begin on a when-ready basis on April 17.
Lion Teck Chiang is a property development and investment company, and also has interests in steel supply.
